mapper.select: SELECT ( CASE WHEN method_name LIKE 'save%' OR method_name LIKE 'add%' THEN 'Create' WHEN method_name LIKE 'delete%' OR method_name LIKE 'remove' THEN 'Delete' WHEN method_name LIKE 'update%' THEN 'Edit' WHEN method_name LIKE 'upload%' THEN 'Upload File' ELSE method_name END ) AS type, count( 0 ) AS count FROM operate_log GROUP BY type ORDER BY count ASC, type ASC

SELECT ( CASE WHEN method_name LIKE 'save%' OR method_name LIKE 'add%' THEN 'Create' WHEN method_name LIKE 'delete%' OR method_name LIKE 'remove' THEN 'Delete' WHEN method_name LIKE 'update%' THEN 'Edit' WHEN method_name LIKE 'upload%' THEN 'Upload File' ELSE method_name END ) AS type, avg( cost_time ) AS avgTime FROM operate_log GROUP BY method_name ORDER BY avgTime DESC, type ASC
